Original Stage 1.7C artwork, dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0.
Reproduce with `node scripts/watershed-region-fixtures.mjs`. Each PNG is
independently rendered at four times its final size then Lanczos3 downsampled.
Botanical is development; harbour is reserved for final assessment. No fonts or
external art. References are offline evaluation only. Old A/B holdouts have
already been observed and are not new blind evidence.
